summary: Fixed blank bash window issue by adding windowsHide:true and stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe'] to all shell: true spawns. The issue was that execFile/spawn with shell:true on Windows was creating visible console windows. Added proper Windows process hiding to env-utils.ts (where command), mcp-handlers.ts (MCP server spawn), and worktree-handlers.ts (batch file spawn).
current_status: All shell spawns now include windowsHide option to prevent console windows from appearing.
